concerns: Between editions: 0 shells in both harness runs (normal and --force-fallback); fees, venue-on-page, abstracts and description are UNPROVEN until a 2027 edition is announced. Cloudflare: plain HTTP gets 403 on every fetch; only the Playwright path reads the site (log shows 'switched to alternate browser profile'). Treat as intermittent-blocked risk on runners; probe 2026-11-09 said cleared.

Terms: Informa Connect website terms (informaconnect.com/website-terms-of-use, linked from the footer) say 'You may not publish, distribute, extract, re-utilise, or reproduce any part of the Site ... other than as permitted by applicable law ... or solely educational, non-commercial purposes.' No explicit ban on automated access or AI use, so not stopped as blocked, but the foreman should decide (Level 2). AMWC (Informa/Euromedicom series, source 148) was onboarded under the same exposure.

Society code 'TAS UK' is my choice (the site's own abbreviation; 'FACE' is only the domain). It must be added to medconf-website/src/lib/taxonomy/societies.ts (name The Aesthetic Show UK, kind event/conference, country UK) before registering, and the foreman may prefer another code.
Canonical site is aestheticshow-uk.com (JSON-LD url); faceconference.com serves the same content. Not checked whether one redirects.
